h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Rourkela

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Rourkela

items.pText: Rourkela is Odisha's steel city, built around a large public sector steel plant, with planned sectors, wide roads and parks between the housing blocks. FunPlay Systems makes outdoor playground equipment for these sector parks, for schools and for private housing in the city. Our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, is about 1,280 km away, and we deliver by road.

Township parks in Rourkela are used every day by families from the surrounding quarters, so equipment wears faster than it would in a private garden. A clear maintenance routine matters as much as the initial choice. We explain at handover what to check and how often, and our after-sales team helps with spare parts when you need them. Share the size of the park and a few photos to start.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: A maintenance routine for busy sector parks

c: Check swings and spring riders every week. Look at chains, hooks and the spring base, and listen for grinding in bearings. Every month, tighten bolts, check that slide edges are smooth and level the surfacing under high-use pieces. After the monsoon, which is heavy in this part of Odisha, inspect footings for washed-out soil.

Write these checks into a register so the maintenance staff can track them. Springs and bearings carry a one-year warranty and are the parts that wear first, so keep a few spares in stock. For neighbouring cities, see our

items.q: How often should playground equipment in a public park be checked?
items.a: A quick visual check every week and a closer check with tightening every month work for most busy parks. Inspect footings and surfacing again after the monsoon.

items.q: Can we get spare parts after the warranty period?
items.a: Contact our after-sales team at aftersales@funplaysystems.com or +91 738 530 0921 with photos of the part and the product name. They will help you with a replacement.

items.q: Do you also install open-air gyms in Rourkela parks?
items.a: Yes. Our Fun Fitness range is built for public parks and walking tracks. See our outdoor gym equipment page for Rourkela for machines that suit adults and senior citizens.
